brief_title: Volatility forecasting with machine learning in financial markets

core_findings.title: Machine learning forecasts of realized volatility: an illustrative core paper
key_findings: Lagged realized volatility remains a strong baseline (RMSE around 0.01 on daily data).
Linear and ridge models remain competitive against shallow ML on short samples.
core_findings.citation_context: Cite in Results/Discussion as empirical baseline for realized-volatility forecasting.

conceptual_references.title: GARCH and hybrid neural networks for volatility: conceptual framing
key_findings: GARCH-family models define the classical econometric benchmark for volatility.
conceptual_references.citation_context: Use in Background when positioning ML against econometric baselines.

seminal_literature.title: Generalized Autoregressive Conditional Heteroskedasticity
key_findings: Foundational GARCH specification for time-varying volatility.
seminal_literature.citation_context: Cite only in theoretical framework as origin of conditional heteroskedasticity models.
